svg.title: Portfolio, web portfolio
svg.desc: Plate VIII. The title PORTFOLIO, drawn as exact construction geometry: public code, live on Vercel. Four boxes joined by arrows: content as typed project records, pages in Next.js and React, three.js and React Three Fiber for the scene, and GSAP and Framer Motion for motion. Below, nine squares, one per project record, the latest two filled, with an ember on the last.
